Document: Lamport Timestamps - Foundational Paper (1978)
The foundational principles of Lamport Timestamps were formulated and published by Leslie Lamport in 1978 within Communications of the ACM. This work revolutionized Distributed Consensus by establishing partial ordering of events in distributed computing systems without requiring synchronized physical clocks. The paradigm introduced strict mathematical foundations that eliminated historical synchrony and performance bottlenecks.

The citation emphasized the enduring architectural impact of their work on modern computing systems, algorithmic correctness, and distributed reliability.

The paradigm introduced strict mathematical foundations that eliminated historical synchrony and performance bottlenecks.
